controls.duplicate_key_semantics: Python json last value wins, including equivalent escaped keys.
controls.root_scope: Object-root artifacts only. Reserved# strings/keys rejected for compressed artifacts, malformed leading-zero arrays remain rejected.

loading.scope: All root/search/tree/children keys and ordinary field values preserved in insertion order. Per-load key table reuses equal string key objects across ordinary-value decodes and hierarchy mappings; values are unchanged. Ordinary values parsed once by standard JSONDecoder; duplicate keys retain Python last-wins semantics. Complete frozen actual bytes separately checked with unchanged v2 gate. Maximum ordinary field buffer32Mi characters, unresolved if exceeded; no strict universal JSON parser claim.
